transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

Since the fan is running but the oven stays cold, while the grill works fine, the most likely cause is that the fan-oven heating element (the large ring at the back of the cavity) has failed. The fan motor working proves it's not a motor issue; if the element were working, you'd feel heat. Before calling an engineer, please do this safe check:
1. Switch off the oven and isolate it at the wall (unplug or turn off the fuse).
2. Wait for everything to cool down completely.
3. Look inside the fan oven cavity at the back. You will see a large metal ring element held by two screws. Check if the metal sheath is cracked, holed, or blistered. If you see visible damage, that suggests the element has failed and needs replacing. If it looks perfectly fine visually, we need to check if it's still getting power (which requires an engineer or a confident DIYer with a multimeter), as the fault could be in the wiring or the selector switch.

its hardwired so i turned it off at the cooker switch on the wall, wasnt a plug. took the back panel off n theres a blister/split in the coil near the bottom with a black mark on it. is that the element gone then?

Because your oven is hardwired into the mains supply, you cannot simply unscrew and replace this part yourself unless you are a qualified electrician or competent DIYer who can safely isolate the appliance at the consumer unit and test for dead circuits. Given the visible damage to the element and the high-voltage nature of the connection, the safest next step is to call an engineer to fit the new fan-oven element. In the meantime, you can still use the grill function as it works fine, but do not attempt to use any other oven heating modes.
